info.name: ASCII16 cartridge with the m6 kernel ROM
info.description: A plain ASCII16 ROM cartridge, page 1 only, carrying the m6 kernel ROM built from Nextor's standalone ASCII16 kernel (build/m6-ascii16-test.rom, copied into the ROM pool by the harness; no checksum, the ROM changes with every build). The bank register at 6000h is the SD Mapper's; there is no storage behind it, so the kernel comes up and stops for want of a volume.
